sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions: WhatsApp for Travel Agencies

items.q: How much does WhatsApp Business API cost for a travel agency in India?
items.a: There's a platform subscription for the chatbot and dashboard, plus Meta's own charges for certain conversation categories. Replies inside the 24-hour customer service window — most routine queries — are free on Meta's side. 18% GST applies, billed in INR, with a plain rate card shared upfront.

items.q: What should I look for in the best WhatsApp API provider for a travel business?
items.a: Confirm the provider is an authorized Meta Business Solution Provider, ask for real deliverability figures from travel clients, and check that support is responsive and India-based. Transparent INR pricing and multi-language chatbot support are good signs too.

items.q: Can WhatsApp send automated flight and trip reminders to travelers?
items.a: Yes. Approved template messages can trigger reminders for flight departures, hotel check-ins, visa documentation deadlines and travel insurance updates, so travelers stay informed without an agent manually following up on each trip.

items.q: Can a WhatsApp chatbot handle hotel and flight booking queries, and show package catalogs?
items.a: Yes. A chatbot can answer availability and pricing questions instantly and let travelers browse tour and holiday packages through an in-chat catalog, capturing the enquiry as a lead even outside business hours.

items.q: Is WhatsApp Business API worth it for small tour operators, not just large agencies?
items.a: Yes. Smaller operators often see the fastest payback, since even a modest volume of enquiries handled through automation and a shared inbox frees up time that would otherwise go into repetitive replies.

items.q: Does WhatsApp integrate with travel booking software, CRM systems and payment links?
items.a: Yes. WhatsApp Business API connects with CRMs like Zoho, HubSpot and Salesforce, along with booking platforms, so enquiries sync automatically. Payment links can also be shared directly in chat to confirm a booking.

items.q: Is DLT registration and opt-in consent mandatory for travel agencies sending WhatsApp messages in India?
items.a: Yes. Promotional and broadcast messages must go only to travelers who've explicitly opted in, and businesses are expected to stay within India's telecom messaging regulations alongside Meta's own commerce and messaging policies.

items.q: How do travel agencies get WhatsApp green tick verification, and are there limits on broadcast messaging?
items.a: Verification follows Meta's Business Verification process, reviewing business name, category and supporting documents before the display name and badge are approved. Broadcast volumes are tied to your account's messaging tier, which typically expands as delivery quality stays strong.
